canonical_truth: In Chapter 42 Magwitch narrates the original joint trial: Compeyson received 7 years, Magwitch 14 years. The disparity at that trial was 7 vs 14, not 14 vs life. Magwitch was later retried (after recapture following his escape in Ch.1) and then sentenced to transportation for life — but that is a separate, later event.
